fact: Digital Rights Frontlines, a civil-society organisation, co-convened with South Sudan's National Communication Authority (the regulator) a two-day consultative workshop on the Data Protection Bill 2025 (Version 1.0), with over 30 stakeholders including MPs, civil society organisations, the UNMISS legal unit and the NCA; the document gives no event date, so the post's published date is used.
The Assembly's Information Committee chair said its work on the cybercrime bill included public consultations and workshops supported by UNESCO and UNMISS.
